instruction: Create a text file at /home/user/project_info.txt that contains the following information: 'Project Name: instructor-embedding', 'Repository URL: https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding', and 'Status: Downloaded'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a text file with three specific lines of information about the instructor-embedding project. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists (0.3 points), (2) path is a file, not directory (0.2 points), (3) file contains all three required text strings (0.5 points). Custom getter uses bash commands to read file content and verify presence of required text.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.3 for file existence, 0.2 for being a file (not directory), 0.5 for containing all required text

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts file state: checks existence using bash test command, verifies it's a file (not directory), and reads content using head command

Metric logic correctly handles expected parameter: when expected.type='rule', get_rule returns config['rules'] directly, so metric receives {'required_text': [...]} and correctly accesses it via expected.get('required_text', [])
Complete coverage of instruction requirements: checks file existence (0.3), file vs directory (0.2), and all three required text strings (0.5 with partial credit)
Scoring logic is sound: awards partial credit proportional to number of matching text strings, full credit when all three are present
Expected values are semantically correct: the three required text strings exactly match what the instruction specifies
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file content → metric performs substring matching for required text → returns appropriate score
